pages.text: Stores up to 5,000 FE for a power network, filled by the [[charging_station|charging stations]] linked to it. It takes no energy any other way.

Link it with a [[linking_bar]] to carry power further along a line: [[charging_rail|charging rails]] in range draw from it as they would from a station, and it finds whatever it doesn't hold elsewhere on its network.

Only the parts of a network in loaded chunks take part.
